description: This JavaScript source file defines a service module for managing 'cases' in a CSGO case-gambling platform. It provides functions to list available cases, retrieve details of a specific case including its drop table, and perform an action to open a case for a user, which involves transactionally updating user balances, inventory, and logging the opening event.

methods.name: listCases()
methods.description: Fetches and returns all available cases with their id, name, and price.

methods.name: getCaseById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific case by id, including its drop table with items and weights.

methods.name: openCaseForUser(userId, caseId)
methods.description: Performs a transactional operation where it deducts the case price from the user's balance, selects a weighted random item from the case, adds this item to the user's inventory, and logs the case opening.
